verdict.rationale: Vue's official TypeScript docs say the defineProps() macro in <script setup> infers prop types from the runtime declaration with no extra annotations, which covers the props half of the story. For emitted events, the docs only say emits 'can also be typed' via runtime or type declaration, which does not clearly show annotation-free inference. A hands-on community report says complex props still need manual PropType casts; this narrows the claim rather than refuting it. missing for 10: explicit documentation that emitted-event payload types are inferred automatically without annotations, evidence that inference covers complex/object prop types without PropType casts, independent corroboration of the inference behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic type inference for component props and emitted events without writing extra type annotations

citations.quote: When using <script setup>, the defineProps() macro supports inferring the props types based on its argument
In <script setup>, the emit function can also be typed using either runtime declaration OR type declaration
